Action Required to Enable Live Writes:
  1. Open GenLayer Studio at https://studio.genlayer.com.
  2. Create a new contract, paste the contents of X/contracts/main.py, and compile.
  3. Deploy with zero constructor arguments.
  4. Set PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=0xYourDeployedAddress in your environment.
  5. Restart or reload the application to start on-chain execution.
